rules.body: All template versions MUST use semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).
A MAJOR version bump IS REQUIRED for breaking changes: rendering strategy change, required variable addition or removal, or destination path change.
A MINOR version bump IS REQUIRED for new optional content or new optional variables.
A PATCH version bump IS REQUIRED for content corrections, typo fixes, or formatting changes.
Version bumps MUST be determined by the template author and MUST NOT be auto-inferred.
Each template version MUST be tracked via a git tag in the format `tmpl/<template-id>/v<version>`.
The specification version MUST be tracked in a `VERSION` file at the repository root.
Per-template version metadata MUST be stored in `.steerspec/versions.json` in the central repository.
Each entry in `versions.json` MUST contain: version string, Blake3 hash, UTC timestamp, and author.
Version entries in `versions.json` MUST be append-only; previous entries MUST NOT be modified or deleted.

notes.content: Breaking changes force target repos to potentially update their local sections or variable definitions, warranting a major bump.
Auto-inferring version bumps from diffs is fragile and cannot reliably distinguish between content corrections (patch) and meaningful additions (minor).
